rules.title: Temporary access must end on time
rules.text: Temporary access must be removed on or before its expiry date. Access still active after expiry is stale.

rules.title: Required metadata
rules.text: Every grant needs an identity, resource, role, purpose and (if temporary) a readable expiry date. Missing data cannot be treated as a violation; it must go to a human reviewer.

rules.title: Accountable owner
rules.text: Every grant needs a named, active owner who is not the grantee. Ownerless or self-approved access is not allowed.

rules.title: Least privilege
rules.text: Access must not exceed the maximum level allowed for the identity type. Temporary access may not carry admin rights, and visitors and contractors may not hold permanent access.

rules.title: Maximum duration
rules.text: Temporary access may not last longer than the maximum days set for the identity type.

rules.title: Delegation rules
rules.text: A delegation must come from a valid, active source, must not outlive its source, must not be circular, and may be passed on at most 1 hop.

rules.title: No access for inactive identities
rules.text: Identities marked inactive (left the institution, ended contract) must hold no active access.

rules.title: Record hygiene
rules.text: Duplicate grants and duplicate or missing record ids need a reviewer to clean up.
